answer.reason: The verses tell what was forbidden about the tree and what happened when its fruit was eaten.

clauses.english: was forbidden to the man on pain of death
clauses.quote: of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it

clauses.english: was eaten from by the woman, who gave its fruit to her husband, and he ate
clauses.quote: she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat
